skipped_checks.justification: Only used as a default; set var.availability_zone to pin a specific AZ.
Port 22 open to the world is the purpose of an SSH honeypot; it is served by Cowrie, not sshd.
The decoy must have a public IP to receive internet attacks.
Detailed monitoring is billed; basic 5-minute metrics drive the status-check alarm.
Decoy SSH must be reachable from the internet; served by Cowrie, not sshd.

Gateway endpoint policies require Principal "*"; access is narrowed by bucket ARN and, for our buckets, to principals of this account. The AL2023 repo is read anonymously by dnf, so it cannot carry a principal condition.
Uses the AWS managed aws/ssm key; a customer managed key costs $1/month (see docs/cost-management.md).
Uses the AWS managed aws/ssm key; a customer managed key costs $1/month.
Operational logs only; 14-day retention is a cost and data-minimisation choice. Evidence lives in S3.
Log groups are encrypted at rest by CloudWatch; a KMS CMK adds monthly cost.
Not in a VPC - a VPC Lambda would need NAT or paid interface endpoints to reach S3/SNS/SSM and the TI APIs.
Environment variables hold only resource names; secrets live in SSM SecureString.
Code signing needs AWS Signer profiles; the package is built reproducibly in CI instead.
New accounts have an account concurrency of 10; reserving concurrency is not possible.
